caseNameFull: Clark, Attorney General, as Successor to the Alien Property Custodian v. Manufacturers Trust Co. Manufacturers Trust Co. v. Clark, Attorney General, as Successor to the Alien Property Custodian and Savorgnan v. United States

opinions.text:
Mc-Grath, present Attorney General, substituted as a party in these cases for Clark.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
